newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Fake cops steal $20,000 from Chinese men in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Fake cops steal $20,000 from Chinese men in Moscow.

text.p: A group of criminals pretending to be police officers stole nearly $20,000 in cash from two Chinese businessmen in Moscow, a police spokesman said on Monday.

He said the fake officers, who wore police uniforms, bundled the Chinese men into a car after a document check, robbed them and then drove them to an empty street, leaving them handcuffed to a garbage container.
Many Chinese traders are active on Moscow street markets, where a legal ban on cash dollar transactions is often ignored.
